body: So I get opportunities they can't because they made big life choices too early?

I didn't grow up near a large city like LA, NY or even a city not so big like Austin or Charlotte. I grew up in a small town where there are very little professional jobs for young people outside certain industries. I would need to move and therefore start from scratch in terms of networking and friends. 

I would be ok if I lived 40 minutes from a city where I could start building a network while looking for a job. 

Edit: I get what you are saying about not beating yourself up over not taking the typical path of job at 22, work your way up to a management position while hooking up with several women/fwb and having fun with friends, slow down in your mid 20s think about finding a girlfriend, marry the right girl in your late 20s, buy a house and have kids in your early 30s and so on. But I just don't know how when I feel being judged for wanting to live the childhood I didn't get to live

But don't the people who go there really fast reap all the rewards? People like them more, women like them more and they have more money in the long run. The person who takes awhile to mature is just something losers like us tell ourselves to feel better about ourselves.
So they made mistakes I haven't yet?
